Class Node

java.lang.Object
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.Node
Direct Known Subclasses:
AppNode, DashboardNode, ElementAccountBarNode, ElementProgressBarNode, LogInNode, MultiNode
public abstract class Node extends Object
A Node is the scaffolding on which the application is built. Each node hosts a partnered IDisplay element, and any number of Injectables. If the node is discarded, its descendents and Injectables are also discarded, and the change to the Node tree is reconciled with the IDisplay tree. Any Node can request an Injectable, which will be sourced rom the nearest ancestor that hosts it. Nodes, like Injectables, are instantiated by the framework, not directly.
